final_report: The patient is an elderly individual (≥80 years) with severe, progressive pancytopenia indicating profound bone marrow failure. This is compounded by multi-organ dysfunction including acute renal failure, hypertensive crisis, pneumonia, and encephalopathy. High clinical frailty (CFS ≥7) and comorbidity burden (CCI ≥6) further reduce physiological reserve, leading to a very high short-term mortality risk.
